state.observers: Actual signed bytes, scoped artifact stats, public manifests, isolated capability metadata files and repository AST graph

contracts.claim: Both Ed25519 signatures bind the observed manifest bytes, signing identity and trusted comment
Release output remains a fresh directory inside the selected repository target; in-tree private key paths are rejected before reading
Actual artifacts and staged files determine missing-artifact, size, shell-only and forbidden-content failures
Every current external registry pack retains pinned official source inputs, summed sizes and explicit activation blockers
Capability inventory exports safe readiness metadata, enabled instruction linkage and honest native activation without raw commands, URLs or environment values
Hermes availability and public plugin metadata agree with actual command discovery; unavailable commands cannot expose installed plugin rows
Imported command aliases resolve only the named source registry in the selected repository
Backend handler evidence requires actual equality or membership branches, including resolved aliases and unions
UI command evidence comes from recognized gateways, command slots and typed command registries; display strings and comments stay excluded
The impact graph keeps handled commands, branch locations and UI caller provenance consistent
Every Vite config evaluation uses the selected checkout physical web root, source alias and build output path
impact: Vite build and serving configuration paths

procedures.claim: Create an in-memory Ed25519 key, sign actual manifest bytes and reject altered bytes and comment
Invoke release path denials before any staging or key read
Run the actual missing-artifact CLI, scan scoped normal/forbidden/oversize files and reject a corrupt observation
Read actual public pinned manifests and reject an inconsistent summed size
Build actual scoped MCP and plugin metadata with a PATH lacking Hermes; reject unsafe activation/metadata observations
Index an actual miniature repository, mutate membership and observe the resulting handler gap; reject corrupt graph evidence
Evaluate actual build and serve configs with explicit isolated ports; reject a divergent source alias without running hooks or services

frontier: No installer build, installation, publication, download or private signing-key provisioning is claimed.
Enabled plugin metadata and native instruction linkage do not prove external MCP/plugin execution.
The impact index proves static command wiring; it does not execute backend or desktop commands.
